summary.note_area: Bottom-up leaf sum excludes inter-module glue logic in structural wrappers (fursoy_s1_core inline RVV integer ALU) and represents flop-array RTL for L1I/BPU/VRF/PRF/FPRF (L1D data SRAM blackboxed).
